title: Plaza: Campus Opportunities Platform
description: Founder of Plaza (formerly Waymark), a platform that brings UC San Diego clubs, students and departments into one place to discover opportunities. Spun out of EIEC's Qualcomm Institute program and sized at 45,000 students and 700+ organizations. I lead a 3-person team across product, engineering and marketing; the core platform is built and the front end is in prototyping alongside customer discovery interviews. Next up: ML recommendations that improve as the user base grows.

title: Automating CREDE's Quarterly Market Report
description: As a finance intern at CREDE Real Estate, I'm automating the company's quarterly market report with a data pipeline for construction-market data. To make the numbers trustworthy, I cataloged 67 market-data sources into a 4-tier reliability framework and traced the report's figures back to verifiable sources such as BLS data via FRED.

title: Stream Enforcement: Piracy Detection Pipeline
description: Data lead on a 5-engineer pipeline that detects pirated UFC streams. I designed the PostgreSQL schemas and built containerized Telegram scrapers; the system processes 10,000+ posts per hour and surfaces about 50 confirmed piracy sites every hour.

title: NYPD Complaints: Are Police Held Liable?
description: DSC 106 Project 2, a persuasive visualization built on ProPublica's dataset of civilian complaints against NYPD officers. Our group argued both sides of whether officers are held liable for allegations; I built an accountability funnel showing how few complaints end in discipline.

title: N-Gram Language Models from Project Gutenberg
description: DSC 80 project in Python: I scraped public-domain books from Project Gutenberg (respecting robots.txt crawl delays), tokenized them with regex into words, punctuation and paragraph markers, and built uniform, unigram and N-gram language models with pandas. The N-gram model is built recursively from lower-order models, computes sentence probabilities from conditional N-gram probabilities, and generates new text in the style of Shakespeare and Homer, falling back to shorter contexts when it doesn't have enough preceding words.

title: Image Processing Toolkit & KNN Classifier
description: DSC 20 project with Karsten Lowe: an object-oriented Python image library built from raw RGB pixel arrays. It includes negate, grayscale, rotation, brightness, pixelation and edge detection with a convolution kernel, standard and premium processing tiers with cost tracking, and a k-nearest-neighbors classifier that labels images (for example, daytime vs. nighttime) by Euclidean pixel distance.

title: UC San Diego DataFest 2026
description: 2nd Place, Best Use of External Data. My team mapped chronic patient journeys and flagged high-risk communities by joining external demographic data. I also co-built and published the official DataFest 2026 event website.

title: Hawaii Restaurant Success Predictor
description: Predicted ratings for 4,301 Hawaii restaurants from choices made before opening. Feature engineering plus a random forest and KMeans geo-clustering raised R² from 0.004 to 0.13. Built in Python with scikit-learn and published as a public web app.

title: EIEC x SoPE Physician-AI Hackathon
description: As co-president of the Engineering Innovators & Entrepreneurs Club, I organized a hackathon pairing physicians with AI builders: about 50 participants, 2 keynotes, industry judges and a $1,000 prize. I handled logistics, registrations and judge outreach.

title: ESG Portfolio Optimizer
description: R&D analyst at UCSD's Sustainable Investment Group. I built a Python backend for ESG-focused portfolio optimization, moved backend services to AWS for speed and scale, researched ESG metrics for the stock analysis models, and maintain the group's web infrastructure on GitHub.

title: Startup Talent Connections at UC San Diego Horizon
description: As an Entrepreneurship Center assistant, I work with startups at UC San Diego Horizon and connect them with student talent; Chakra Tech hired EIEC members I introduced. I also help run Meet the VC office hours and investor events with BOW Capital.

title: South Bay Chill
description: Founded a community wellness brand in Hermosa Beach built around beach ice-bath events. I ran logistics, marketing and sales, coordinated partners and sponsors, and used attendance data to adjust outreach and grow engagement.

title: Movie Review Analysis System
description: A C++ text-search application over large sets of movie reviews. It uses a hash table for fast keyword lookup and a priority queue to rank results by relevance, with an object-oriented design built to scale to lots of text.

title: Interactive Campus Map
description: A Google Maps-style web app recreating Stanford's campus map in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with zoom, panning and clickable building markers.
